picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool (Jul 7): legendary Final Fantasy artist Yoshitaka Amano's nuanced 'AI is a tool, only humans create the original' stance is a high-credibility artist perspective the section hasn't covered.
picks.excerpt: Interviewed at Anime Expo about ZAN, his new hand-drawn animated series, legendary Final Fantasy artist Yoshitaka Amano says he sees AI as a tool, not an enemy — but insists 'only humans can create the original,' arguing hand-drawn imperfection matters more than ever in an age of generative art.

picks.rationale: Most actionable pick: Epic's official State of Unreal demo of image/video generation models wired into the UE art pipeline directly changes how game artists will direct generative output.
picks.excerpt: Epic's State of Unreal session shows how Unreal Engine tools used in tandem with image and video generation models let artists direct generative output with 'greater intention and creative control' — an official look at how genAI plugs into the UE art pipeline, coming soon.

picks.rationale: Usable today in the free Unity AI beta; a distinct feature (AI-driven scene assembly) from the 7/07 asset-audit card, and keeps engine coverage balanced between Unreal and Unity.
picks.excerpt: New official Unity short demos Unity AI (Beta) automating scene setup so developers spend more time iterating on ideas — a sibling feature to the asset-audit workflow covered on 7/07, this one focused on AI-driven scene assembly inside the editor.

picks.rationale: Fresh (Jul 7) cautionary case of AI slop slipping into officially licensed game merch marketing — distinct from the earlier Sonic ARG data story and adds an industry-watch angle to the mix.
picks.excerpt: Promo images for officially licensed Sega Dreamcast controller keychains appear AI-altered — zooming into the Sega logo reveals vague cursive-shaped lines instead of real letters — the latest case of AI-generated marketing art slipping into licensed game merchandise.
